title: Trace-scaling cocycle stability: four exact views
normalization: All action integrals use Lebesgue ds, never ds/(2*pi).

noncommuting_cocycle.v: v(q)=exp(i q X) exp(i q Z)
noncommuting_cocycle.c: c_s(q)=v(q)^* v(q+s)=exp(-i q Z) (exp(i s X) exp(i s Z)) exp(i q Z)

modulation.scope: Actual density model for the identity cocycle; matrices displayed are integrands before integration, not L_r or R_r.

localization.scope: Auxiliary projection-comparison example; it fails equality on central pieces and is not a linking-theorem counterexample.

human_source_context.trace_scaling_coordinate: Takesaki, Theory of Operator Algebras II, XII.1, Lemma 1.2, printed pp.366-367; locator recorded in OA-FLOW-L19.md#l19-reading. No book figure is used.
